stance_basis: paraphrase describing Plewa's alternative proposal to upgrade College Ave. instead of building the Airport Spur
summary: John Plewa, State Representative for the 20th Assembly District, is referenced in the document as having proposed an alternative to the Airport Spur — upgrading College Avenue for use to and from Mitchell Field — which a commenter cites as a preferable option. He is not directly quoted but is paraphrased as opposing the Airport Spur project by advocating for this less costly alternative that would avoid new construction.
complaint_summary: A commenter (lobbyist for balanced transportation) references State Representative John Plewa's proposal to upgrade College Avenue as an alternative to constructing the Airport Spur, presenting it as a viable option that would meet the Division of Highways' stated goals without the expense of a new 1.5-mile interstate-type facility.
summary_quote: Stated that the 1972 EIS is no longer valid because of the increase in noise levels from traffic and the opening of the East-West Runway at Mitchell Field.

mentions.quote: An attractive alternative has been proposed by State Representative John Plewa. He has suggested the upgrading of College Ave. for use to and from Mitchell Field.
Stated that the 1972 EIS is no longer valid because of the increase in noise levels from traffic and the opening of the East-West Runway at Mitchell Field.
